title: Zoho Developer
summary: Builds and customises business apps on Zoho, such as Zoho CRM and Zoho Creator, using Deluge, Zoho's own scripting language. Usually works at a Zoho partner or in a company's internal IT team, turning sales, service and operations processes into apps and automations.
dailyDuties: Write Deluge functions and workflows for client requests
Build or change forms, reports and pages in Zoho Creator
Configure Zoho CRM modules, blueprints and workflow rules
Connect Zoho apps to other tools through APIs and webhooks
Meet clients to understand their process and agree on changes
Fix issues raised by users after go-live

skills.expectation: Write Deluge custom functions, workflows and scheduled scripts
Build Zoho Creator apps with forms, reports, pages and workflows
Customise Zoho CRM and other Zoho One apps with modules, layouts, blueprints and workflow rules
Connect Zoho apps to other systems through REST APIs, webhooks and connections
Turn a client's business needs into a Zoho solution design
Map a business process before automating it in Zoho
Explain solutions to clients and train their users
Know how sales teams use a CRM for leads, deals and pipelines
Build simple widgets and pages with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Query data for Zoho Analytics reports
Move data from spreadsheets or old systems into Zoho
Run user acceptance testing with the client before go-live
